scenario.name: Heading west into a dead end
scenario.heading: W
scenario.expected: Goes forward west to (2,4) at tick 1, where front, left, and right are blocked. Stops for ticks 2-6 and moves backward (east) for ticks 7-11 to (7,4). Both sides are open there: turns right for ticks 12-16, which is toward the north, and goes forward north with cleaning from tick 17.
